AT.L2-3.2.1.title: Literacy Training and Awareness
objectives: Security literacy training is provided to system users as part of initial training for new users
Security literacy training is provided to system users annually (every 12 months) or following significant changesafter initial training
Security literacy training is provided to system users when required by system changes or following annually (every 12 months) or following significant changes
Security literacy training is provided to system users on recognizing indicators of insider threat
Security literacy training is provided to system users on reporting indicators of insider threat
Security literacy training is provided to system users on recognizing indicators of social engineering
Security literacy training is provided to system users on reporting indicators of social engineering
Security literacy training is provided to system users on recognizing indicators of social mining
Security literacy training is provided to system users on reporting indicators of social mining
Security literacy training content is updated the Authorizing Official (AO) or Information System Security Manager (ISSM)
Security literacy training content is updated following the Information System Security Officer (ISSO) or designated System Administrator under ISSM oversight

AT.L2-3.2.2.title: Role-Based Training
objectives: Role-based security training is provided to organizational personnel before authorizing access to the system or CUI
Role-based security training is provided to organizational personnel before performing assigned duties
Role-based security training is provided to organizational personnel the DoD-approved system use notification bannerafter initial training
Role-based security training is provided to organizational personnel when required by system changes or following before authentication is completed (at every login prompt)
Role-based security training content is updated each login session
Role-based security training content is updated following all users accessing systems that store, process, or transmit CUI

AT.L2-3.2.3.title: Provide Security Awareness Training on Recognizing and Reporting Potential Indicators of Insider Threat
objectives: Provide security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat.
